records.title: Evolving Contextual Safety in Multi-Modal Large Language Models via Inference-Time Self-Reflective Memory
records.reason: The primary paper adds a retrieved self-reflective memory to multimodal safety prompts at inference time, but its reported objective is safety behavior and it does not establish an inference-cost, latency, memory, or serving improvement; relevance to inference optimization remains weak.

records.title: AD-Copilot: A Vision-Language Assistant for Industrial Anomaly Detection via Visual In-context Comparison
records.reason: The abstract describes industrial anomaly detection data, a comparison encoder, and task accuracy/localization; it does not address model inference cost or serving.

records.title: From Text to Forecasts: Bridging Modality Gap with Temporal Evolution Semantic Space
records.reason: The abstract studies text-to-time-series forecasting through semantic temporal features and forecasting error; it is not LLM inference optimization.

records.title: DiT-IC: Aligned Diffusion Transformer for Efficient Image Compression
records.reason: The abstract optimizes diffusion-based image compression sampling and reconstruction, not language model inference.

records.title: Senna-2: Aligning VLM and End-to-End Driving Policy for Consistent Decision Making and Planning
records.reason: The abstract aligns VLM decisions and end-to-end driving policies through staged training and driving-safety objectives; no inference efficiency mechanism is reported.
